recap.text: Donut's Beguiler Box holds a tome called Minion Army, a spell that costs fifty spell points and makes hostile enemies fight for you instead of against you. Donut has twenty-four points, so she tries reading it anyway, and it won't let her: you can't teach yourself a spell you can't cast. She pouts for a good minute straight, and Carl tells her they will trade it for something better, or keep it until she can use it.

Carl wakes to find Donut has already read the Tome of Minion Army. Her Intelligence reads fifty-two: forty, four from the butterfly charm and tiara, and twenty percent of base from the Good Rest and shower buffs, which a bug hides from the stat list but not her spell points. It takes five minutes to cast, roots her, and cools down five hours. It hits only intelligent mobs, two percent of whom turn on friends at level one.

Doctor Bones tells Carl he is honing a spell that lasts pretty much forever on weak subjects. He calls it Conscript, and Carl feels a sudden revulsion, having read that it was used a lot against crawlers on the ninth floor. Donut casts Minion Army for the first time, rooted in place for four minutes, and thinks she wasted it until the experience comes in: birds in the tornado are fighting each other.

beats.headline: Twenty-six points short
beats.text: Donut's Beguiler Box holds a tome called Minion Army. Its spell costs fifty spell points to cast and makes hostile enemies fight for you instead of against you. A great spell, but Donut currently has twenty-four points. She tries reading it anyway and it won't let her: apparently you can't teach yourself spells you can't cast. She pouts for a good minute straight. Don't worry, Carl says. They will trade it for something better, or keep it until she can use it.
beats.gist: Donut's Beguiler Box holds Minion Army, a fifty-point spell she cannot cast with her twenty-four points.

beats.headline: Read at fifty-two
beats.text: Carl wakes from a nap to Donut's discovery. Her Intelligence is forty, her butterfly charm and new tiara add four, and the Good Rest and shower buffs add twenty percent to her base, which a bug keeps off the stat list but not off her spell points. Fifty-two. Of course she has read the tome already. The spell is simple on the surface and convoluted underneath: five minutes to cast, stuck in place while casting, a five-hour cooldown, intelligent mobs only, and at level one a two percent chance for each to turn on its friends.
beats.gist: Donut's Intelligence reaches fifty-two, and she has already read the Minion Army tome.

beats.headline: Not the same as Conscript
beats.text: Doctor Bones is honing a spell whose effect on weak subjects lasts pretty much forever. Carl asks its name: Donut has one similar, called Minion Army, that she hasn't tried yet. Minion Army is a battlefield sabotage spell, quite effective, says Doctor Bones, but it has a long casting time and it is temporary. His is simply called Conscript. Carl feels a sudden revulsion. He has read about that spell, used a lot against crawlers on the ninth floor.
beats.gist: Donut has an untried spell, Minion Army, while Doctor Bones's Conscript lasts nearly forever, and Carl feels revulsion.

beats.headline: Rooted for four minutes
beats.text: Donut glows as she casts Minion Army for the first time. She has held it back since the first floor because it roots her in place, for four minutes now, and with Imani and Samantha enhancing it the two percent should be about five. A countdown appears over her, Rooted in Place, and the sluggalos charge the demons early. When the ice and the corpses settle she thinks she cast it for nothing, until the experience starts coming in: birds in the lower part of the tornado over the building are fighting each other.
beats.gist: Donut casts Minion Army for the first time and roots herself for four minutes while the sluggalos charge.
